lastSummary: NC-020 fixed: Cross-platform path containment. (1) Added isPathAbsoluteCrossPlatform() that detects Windows absolute paths (drive letters, drive-relative, UNC, device, extended-length) on any host OS. (2) Added containsNullBytes() validator. (3) Added isPathSafeCrossPlatform() composite check. (4) Both resolveWorkspacePath() and checkPathWithinWorkspace() now apply cross-platform safety checks for non-host-absolute paths, while still allowing host-absolute paths through the existing containment logic. (5) Updated editValidation.test.ts null-byte test to expect rejection. (6) 61 new cross-platform path containment tests cover: isPathAbsoluteCrossPlatform (23 tests), containsNullBytes (5 tests), isPathSafeCrossPlatform (8 tests), checkPathWithinWorkspace cross-platform (19 tests), resolveWorkspacePath cross-platform (8 tests). (7) Exported new utilities from barrel. 1009/1009 unit tests pass. Build clean. All type-checks clean.
